fest_awakening.title: The Awakening
fest_awakening.hint: Something blooms early in spring. The lone rowan seems to know.
fest_awakening.clue: The rowan is covered in tight white buds. In a few days, something will open.
fest_awakening.blurb: The lone rowan blossoms all at once, and the whole clearing follows. Lanterns lead to it under a woven arch. Wishes are hung on its posts.

spots.label: Pick a dawnbell
spots.text: A dawnbell: it rings once when picked, then never again.

spots.label: Hang a wish on the rowan
spots.text: You tie a strip of cloth to the post and a blossom falls into your hand. You press it in your book.

fest_fireflies.title: The Firefly Evening
fest_fireflies.hint: On one summer night, the pond lights up. More fireflies every evening before it.
fest_fireflies.clue: There are more fireflies over the pond tonight than any night so far. They seem to be gathering for something.
fest_fireflies.blurb: Lanterns float on lily pads in a ring on the pond, and hundreds of fireflies come down to meet their reflections.

spots.label: Catch fireflies in a jar
spots.text: You cup your hands over the light and it settles into the jar.

spots.label: Lift a moon lily from the water
spots.text: A moon lily, open only tonight. It smells like rain on warm stone.

spots.label: Set a lantern on the water
spots.text: Your lantern drifts out to join the ring.

fest_forgotten.title: The Harvest of Forgotten Things
fest_forgotten.hint: In autumn the forest gives back what it took. Watch the leaf piles.
fest_forgotten.clue: The leaves are piling up in odd heaps on the ruin path, as if something is being buried, or uncovered.
fest_forgotten.blurb: The year turns over its leaves. A bonfire burns on the ruin path; lost things surface in the heaps and are laid out on a long table.

spots.label: Search the leaf heap
spots.text: Under the leaves: a brass compass. It points at the ruin, not north.

spots.label: Search the leaf heap
spots.text: A folded letter, never sent. The ink has run, but one line is still clear.

spots.label: Search the leaf heap
spots.text: A wind-up tin bird. It still has one chirp in it.

spots.label: Search the leaf heap
spots.text: Only leaves, and a beetle who is annoyed with you.

spots.label: Pick an ember cap from the ring
spots.text: An ember cap: warm to hold, glowing faintly orange underneath.

spots.label: Leave something on the table
spots.text: You leave a {item} on the table among the forgotten things.

fest_silent_tide.title: The Silent Tide
fest_silent_tide.hint: Deep in winter, the pond ice turns clear for one night. Listen to the ice before it.
fest_silent_tide.clue: The pond ice rings faintly under your boots, and for a moment you think you see a light far below it.
fest_silent_tide.blurb: For one night the pond ice clears like glass. Under it are the lights of the drowned town, still burning. Kneel at the ice hole and fish the deep.

spots.label: Light an ice lantern
spots.text: You light the lantern. The ice around it rings like a glass touched with a wet finger.
